svg.title: Gaussian Curvature Field V4
svg.desc: Computed Gaussian curvature on a torus; color encodes the analytic curvature value and changes sign across the torus.

g.text: Color must encode mathematics, not decoration.
Torus curvature K(v)=cos(v)/[r(R+r cos(v))]; positive outer region and negative inner region.
Each polygon color is computed from Gaussian curvature at its parameter-cell midpoint.
